notes.title: Release 2.6.4
notes.content:
• Experience a significant boost in AI performance with over a 50% increase in speed.

• Enjoy an upgraded auditory experience with new sounds added throughout the user interface.

• We've added a direct messaging feature that allows you to easily contact us for bug reports or feature requests, ensuring your feedback helps shape future updates.
